de: Nguyên hàm của hàm số $f\left( x \right)=\left( \cos\frac{x}{2}+\sin\frac{x}{2} \right)^{2}$ là:
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int \left( \cos\frac{x}{2}+\sin\frac{x}{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\int \left( \cos^{\text{2}}\frac{x}{2}+\sin^{2}\frac{x}{2}+2\cos\frac{x}{2}.\sin\frac{x}{2} \right)\text{d}x$
$=\int \left( 1+\sin x \right)\text{d}x=\int \text{d}x+\int \sin x\text{d}x=x-\cos x+C$.
